notes.title: UPCOMING UPDATE
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I apologize for the delay, as some of you may already know, my team quit so I'm working on my own, but something else, more personal kept me from working for some time.

Anyways, I've been reading very thoroughly your reviews, posts and messages and there are a few things I must address.

1.- Use actual SCPs, don't make up new ones
From what I've been reading, the SCPs listed in the actual Wiki are copyrighted, but I decided to ask a couple guys I know who actually work on the Wiki site about whether that's true or not, if they are not copyrighted then you can be sure I'm gonna use some of them (at least those who fit into the genre).

2.- Graphics look bad
This game is supposed to look retro-ish with more simple geometry and not too many details, however, I don't want something like that to kill this game so I'll make the levels more detailed.

3.- Doesn't feel like an SCP game
That's because I'm still working on the actual campaign and, in order to keep you busy while I work on it, I released the "Survival Mode", but I decided to scrap that game mode and focus all of my attention into the campaign now, one more reason why I haven't posted in a while.

Believe me guys, don't judge the actual game just by looking at the survival mode, this IS an SCP game after all, I don't blame you tho, so far the Survival Mode is all I've shown to you but trust me, you're gonna love the campaign.

This game is in Early Access for a reason, I already have a story and other elements for the game, but you are the ones who will actually play this and I expect you to enjoy this game.

Since this game is in a very early stage you can be sure as hell that I can still change anything I want or have to in accordance to what you like and expect from this.

Having said this, post here or in the forums constructive suggestions and ideas you may have for this game, part of its canvas is still blank and open for you to write on so please do so.

I'm gonna post a video later this week with new stuff I've been working on and might appear in the first campaign demo level.

Regards!

notes.title: v1.2 IS UP!
notes.content:
That's right everyone, the update v1.2 is up now! The changes are small but hopefully a good improvement.

List of changes:

- New sounds for rifle
- Rifle is fully automatic! You can now press and hold the shooting button for the rifle to shoot nonstop
- New sounds for pistol
- Muzzle flash & bullet impact effects for both rifle and pistol added
- Fixed player clip and issue with disappearing objects
- Maps have real names now!
- Contact shadows, this will add more realism to the lighting as well as add more detail and depth to textures
- Removed the bulletin board, it was not needed tbh


List of changes to expect from v1.5

- New weapon
- New SCP into Survival Mode
- Small prequel campaign level with new SCP
- Bullet impact marks
- Improved interface for pause menu
- Changes to the settings from the main menu
- Music
- New health bar design
- Removing the framerate counter (or making it optional from the settings)
- General improvement to the UI

And that's all for now, it's not much but there are three reasons for that, the first is that I'm also working on the update v1.5, the second was choosing the names for the maps, and the third and most important is the fact that my [strike]gf is 3 months pregnant![/strike](suffered miscarriage recently so nvm...).

Anyways, I don't have a date yet for the v1.5 update but I expect it to be soon. Have a great day/night everyone!

notes.title: Update #3 - v1.1 IS UP
notes.content:
That's right folks, the update is up now!

As I said, it's a small one, this update just fixes the issue in which players could escape the boundaries of the levels, there shouldn't be any way now to do that... I think lol.

I'll keep looking for more exploits, but if you find any please be sure to let me know, the game needs to be as neat(o) as possible so your feedback is really important.

Have a great day/night everyone!

notes.title: Update #3 (v1.1) - TONIGHT
notes.content:
Sup everyone! Just letting you know the new update I mentioned in the last announcement will be released tonight!

This update doesn't bring anything exciting, it's just a bug fix. As some of you may have noticed, there were ways to escape the boundaries of every map, so I went through every single map and fixed that problem... :-)

I'll keep looking for potential exploits but if you find anything else that needs to be fixed please make sure to let me know so I make the necessary changes.


As for the Update #4 (v1.5)...

It shouldn't take long, the updates will be substantial but not necessarily difficult to finish however, I won't promise an specific release date, but it shouldn't take longer than two weeks. That's all.

I hope you liked this little heads up and please share this game with friends and family, we haven't reached 50 downloads so it would be awesome if we did :D

Have a great day/night everyone!

notes.title: Third Update (v1.5) Release Date & Details
notes.content:
Hello pals and gals, I hope you liked this recent update, it doesn't have all the stuff that were promised but there's a reason for that, the two friends who were helping me with the game recently quit... apparently they were extremely disappointed at the fact that the game only has approx. 40 downloads after all this time...

While it is indeed sad I really don't care, I still have my hopes as high as ever that this game's community will grow!

There's no defined release date for the next update but it should be this month... there will be two updates in fact, it goes like this:


[b]Update #3 (v1.1)[/b]

This update will address one thing that really needs to get fixed... bugs. There are ways to escape the boundaries of almost all maps, I'm always eager to find glitches or exploits in videogames and I'm pretty good at it so I think keeping others from doing that in my game will be quite easy :-B


[b]Update #4 (v1.5)[/b]

This is the good one.

Changes that will definitely happen:
- New SCP that I've been teasing since the game's release! (finally right? lol)
- Muzzle flash effects to guns.
- Impact effect for projectiles.
- Improved projectiles' effects.
- Improved pistol sound.

Changes that might happen:
- Replace yet another existing survival mode map.
- Add official names to the maps.
- Add music.

Well, that's all for now, stay tuned and, if you like this game PLEASE spread the word, tell friends and family about this game that will really help me out a lot to make this game even better.

Thank you for reading and have a great day/night everyone!

notes.title: [GAME UPDATE] UPDATE 0.5
notes.content:
Update 0.5 is here! Why not call it update 1.0 tho? Well, the reason for that is that there are pending changes to be done for this update, here's the changelog for this specific update:


-New weapon >>
That's right, the new energy pistol is here! More powerful than the rifle.


-Removed sprint >>
This has two reasons, the first being to improve the player's gaming experience, now you don't have to worry about running, aiming and shooting and repeating, now you move faster at default walk and can shot while moving among the enemies! The second reason is that older games from late 90's/early 2000 don't use sprint, you always move at the same speed, and since this is a retro-styled game... yeah.


-Tweaked enemies waves >>
Although their individual stats remain the same there are slightly less of them now, this along with the smoother player movement should make the game a bit easier.


-New powerups and tweaks >>
There are health packs and ammo packs now! However, to balance things out and make up for the easier gameplay, the omnicrates (the green boxes) give less ammo.


-Quit Button >>
Yeah, it was needed... sorry lol.


-Bug Fix >>
Someone reported a rather funny bug that would allow you to lift yourself up in the sky and leave the map, yeah we fixed that.


>> Improved enemies' sounds >>
They are the same sounds at the moment, however, we made some modifications with the way they play, now you can only hear them properly when they are in proximity, making those that are far less distracting.



WHAT TO EXPECT FOR UPDATE 1.0 >>

Update 1.0 (which was supposed to be today instead of 0.5) was meant to add the following things, but we decided to delay them because they need more work to be really good, you can expect these changes next Friday:

- New Map
- New Enemy
- Improved Player Clips
- Improved Item Spawn Points
- Improvement to existing maps
- Database of SCPs Encountered

That's all for now! Feel free to comment your opinions and suggestions! You are the core of this game and its future!

notes.title: Give Us Your Suggestions Here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are extremely excited to publish this game and we are really working hard to make sure you like it!

Keep in mind however that this is an Early Access game, which means A LOT is going to improve, be polished and even be replaced/removed, and the reason for that will be YOU. 

We want YOU, the community, the gamer, to tell us what to do, tell us how to improve this game to meet your expectations. 

Maybe some of you may want to suggest others to wait until the game is complete to get this game but that would not be helpful for us during the development stage, after all, the purpose of an Early Access game is for the developer to work along with the community for a greater good, which is turning the game into a truly awesome and worth experience.

That's why we opened this thread, so you can share with us every suggestion you got, the game hasn't been released yet but you can still tell us what you are hoping to see!

Thanks for reading and we hope you get to enjoy playing this game as much as we're enjoying working on it :D

- Derelict Development Team
